reason: Second EVENT: First Trial banner uses the same F079(ir) token that runtime dropped in the first EVENT banner. Re-encode only this special-renderer occurrence while preserving exact 28-byte title length, colon, spacing, terminator, pointers and MTE dictionary.

changes.encoding_before: EVENT: + F + F079(ir) + F02F(st) + space + T + F061(ri) + F037(al)
changes.encoding_after: E + V + F04C(EN) + T + colon + space + explicit F I R + F02F(st) + space + T + F061(ri) + F037(al)
changes.note: F04C(EN) frees exactly two bytes so I and R can be explicit. F02F(st), F061(ri), F037(al) are retained. No repointing.
